card.name: Partway through concomitant and androgen
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split word such as concom|itant, and|rogen or nonhorm|onal, in drug-interaction and adverse-reaction text. It also fires on a few small words like "to" or "alternative" after "and" or "exposed".

modes.label: concomitant
modes.description: The ending of 'concomitant' when describing other drugs taken together with the one in question.
modes.example: Most of the patients were receiving concom<<itant>> immunosuppressants.

modes.label: androgen / hormonal
modes.description: The ending of 'androgen' or 'hormonal' in names of hormone pathways or therapies.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Androgen Deprivation Therapy and Other Therapies Targeting the And<<rogen>> Pathway

modes.label: linking words
modes.description: A small linking word in an instruction or exposure clause, e.g. 'alternative' after 'and' or 'to' after 'exposed'.
modes.example: and<< alternative>> therapy should be instituted

card.writes: It promotes mostly Chinese words meaning array, variable, factor and function, plus 'variables', so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up near the end of the long words 'concomitant' and 'androgen' in drug-interaction text.
